title: Returned-Payment Fee Ageing Bands — Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
**Rule.** The ageing reduction on a Rental Property Service Contracts returned-payment fee is set by the whole calendar months that have passed from the day the payment was billed back to the day the fee is billed:

| Whole calendar months passed | Ageing reduction |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 0.50 |
| 6 to 11 | 0.25 |
| fewer than 6 | 0 |

The day the payment was billed back is the date of the most recent returned payment charge in the contract's billing history.

**How the reduction acts.** The returned-payment fee is the fee as it stands after every dollar amount added to it or taken off it, times one less the ageing reduction, rounded to the cent once at the end.

## Hypothetical fees (fee before the reduction $35.00)

| Returned payment billed back | Fee billed | Whole months | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 January | 9 July | 5 | $35.00 |
| 10 January | 10 July | 6 | $35.00 times 0.75: **$26.25** |
| 10 January | 9 January the next year | 11 | **$26.25** |
| 10 January | 10 January the next year | 12 | $35.00 times 0.50: **$17.50** |
